note: The two sets are nearly identical in content: both capture the same nine claims with the same values and quotes, including the 18'-0" solar envelope, 2'-9 1/2" finished floor, 1/8" cable railing, 2 X APSE-20 (40 tubes), and the cedar/steel railing and siding materials. Differences are cosmetic: B labels some attributes 'material/size' and 'material/dimension' and adds 'steel' as a condition on the cable railing, while A keeps plain 'material'. Both repeat the 1x4 tongue-and-groove cedar fact under both 'siding' and 'cladding', and both use a stitched quote for the railing posts claim. Neither set is meaningfully more correct or complete than the other.
remarks: Both sets state the 1x4 T&G cedar twice (as siding and as cladding) — the page labels it '1 X 4 CEDAR T&G SIDING' and '1x4 TONNGUE & GROOVE CEDAR CLADDING', likely the same material. The railing-posts quote 'RAILING POSTS STEEL FLATBAR' is stitched from separate text fragments ('POWDERCOATED STEEL FLATBAR' and 'RAILING POSTS') and drops the 'POWDERCOATED' condition. Both sets omit the PV SOLAR ARRAY (called out twice on the elevations) and the 1/4" = 1'-0" scale; the text layer contains a typo 'TONNGUE' faithfully reproduced in the quotes.
